title: Existing Vegetation Map 2024 / 現存植生図2024

title: GSI DEM hierarchy and tile specification
resolution: DEM1A ~1 m; DEM5A/B/C ~5 m; DEM10B ~10 m
coverage: varies by DEM class; DEM10B nationwide
crs: current download service JGD2024; web tile scheme
reconstruction_use: Bare-earth terrain source hierarchy. Use the highest available class per cell and retain source metadata.
notes: GSI states individual tile values may differ between DEM classes and across source boundaries.
